limits: Actual source loader/IRQ/reader/FIFO publishes per IRQ while the Z80 consumes; no precomputed replay or synthetic foreground substitute. Native source output/state/IRQ logs checked against reference; proof mode also checks all16intermediate state copies; bare mode checks final RAM/audio and hashes without those copies.

Diagnostic markers delimit publisher callbacks and loader finish. Writes before finish/outside publisher show overlap with the live loading call, including remaining diagnostic overhead. Loader/delivery times checked against independent native HV reads. No deadline acceptance gate; no DMA/native IRQ/input/boot/full-game/hardware proof. Stop only after drain; no fatal abort implementation.
Native PSG-word diagnostic markers add writes outside the checked Z80 source-byte stream; these kernels measure source-byte transport/timing and do not establish an unmodified audio waveform.
